purpose: UTC dates used in merchant-local reporting
candidate:
SELECT m.merchant_id, CAST(c.captured_at_utc AS DATE) AS local_day,
       CAST(SUM(c.amount) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS captured
FROM captures c JOIN authorisations a ON c.auth_id = a.auth_id JOIN merchants m ON a.merchant_id = m.merchant_id
GROUP BY m.merchant_id, CAST(c.captured_at_utc AS DATE)
